Formal patient linkage remains unverified; zero new patients and zero new cohorts is conservative accounting rather than proven person identity.

findings.topic: Intended claim and mechanistic evidence limits
findings.finding: Useful wound control during continued treatment is retained as an analytical development question, not established efficacy. Off-treatment persistence and complete barrier restoration remain separate unproved claims. Pretreatment before induced cell differentiation, incomplete cornification, and unchanged aggregation are not mislabeled as delayed mature-tissue rescue. No unconditional requirement for an additional experiment is introduced.

open_issues.issue: P2 genotype/transcript discrepancy remains unresolved; explicit artifact handling is adequate.
Formal patient linkage, site-specific dose/area, and causal pain/lesion effect size remain unavailable; no new clinical denominator is credited.
Chronic dermal/systemic exposure, robust safety ascertainment, functional tissue measurements and withdrawal outcomes remain unestablished.
This review independently reopened the three core clinical primary texts. It did not repeat the complete update search, authenticate unpublished records, or resolve metadata-only peripheral sources.
